ios.desc:
See your self in a different style using Slidebits Studio. The makeup feature allows you to imagine yourself in popular makeup styles styles. The music feature allows you to make a full song instrumentals with popular genres. There's also an image editor that makes editing or creating images super easy.

Slidebits provides an easy to use user interface so anyone young or old, amateur to professional can do casual image editing. Easily create cartoons and add voiceover to make them speak. Describe it and watch it create.Enhance old or blurry photos, combine images, create AI avatars with high resemblance, transform an image into a video, transform an image into an artistic painting, 

Slidebits leverages the best AI models, Seedance, Nano Banana, Flux Kontext, Kling, and provides an easy to use app to make impressive designs on the go, without worrying about which model to use, Slidebits leverages the best tool for the task.

Release your creativity with Slidebits.

quotes.story_title: I wasted years of my life in crypto

quotes.text:
I spend around $20 a month through API fees using my own harness, https://slidebits.com/isogen. Nothing too special, I prompt it produces file changes using grep and vector search and I can individually accept which files.

I also work on a consumer AI application
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/slidebits-studio/id1138731130

For comparison someone showed me an internal company tool he was working on. He had Claude agents dangerously skipping permissions and firing up github branches through a vm sandbox just to make a single feature change. One agent to code and the other to review.
